_comment: The agent writes here instead of guessing on anything ambiguous or hard-gated. Empty = nothing waiting.

items.blocks: Phase-1 seed build (builder/build.py fetch_pages + page generation)
items.summary: Pipe is built and tested; still BLOCKED on real prospector data. fetch_pages() now reads a flat clinic list from data/prospector/*.json (format chosen, see data/prospector/SCHEMA.md). Cannot build the seed until real clinic records land there — CLAUDE.md forbids inventing a source or building from filler.
items.detail: fetch_pages() in builder/build.py was wired to read data/prospector/*.json, group clinics into treatment x neighborhood pages over config seed_scope, and run each page through the existing quality gate. Verified end-to-end with a throwaway synthetic fixture (since deleted, not committed): good clinics built, a clinic with scraped review text and one with an unconsented before/after image were correctly gated out. What is still missing is the actual real data file(s).
what_i_asked: Where does the prospector output for the seed scope live, and how should fetch_pages() read it (local file/dir, local path outside repo, HTTP/API endpoint, or a prospector skill run)?
What is the shape of each record, so I can map it to the page/template contract (per-page JSON like sample_clinic.json, flat clinic list, CSV, or other)?

answer_received.location: i'll published as directory at some point using vercel or cloudflare

why_this_does_not_unblock: The location answer describes the OUTPUT/publish side (a live directory site on Vercel/Cloudflare). Publishing is HARD-GATED and not the builder's job. It does not tell me where the prospector INPUT clinic data lives.
The format is unknown, so I cannot write a correct fetch_pages() mapping.
Building the seed anyway would require inventing clinics or shipping near-duplicate template filler, which the quality gate explicitly prohibits. Per CLAUDE.md I must not invent a source.

what_i_need_to_proceed.decided: Source location + format are settled: flat JSON array of real clinic records in data/prospector/*.json per data/prospector/SCHEMA.md. fetch_pages() is written and tested.
what_i_need_to_proceed.prospector_run_outcome: Ran the prospector via web research (no Google Places tool in this environment). Found real candidate clinics for all four neighborhoods — see data/seed_candidates_DRAFT.json. Identities are real; treatments/addresses/phones are unverified and ratings are null.
what_i_need_to_proceed.HARD_BLOCKER_ratings_api: The quality gate requires ratings from a PERMITTED API (Google Places). This environment has no places_search tool, and reading the Places API key from env is hard-gated for me. I will NOT scrape Google/Yelp ratings (prohibited). Therefore I cannot produce gate-passing pages — every page needs valid AggregateRating from a permitted source. THIS is the current wall.
what_i_need_to_proceed.decision_needed_ratings_source: Choose how compliant ratings get supplied: (a) wire a Google Places API tool/MCP I can call (read-only), (b) have your existing prospector pipeline (which has Places access) emit a rated data/prospector/clinics.json, or (c) hand me a clinics.json that already includes rating + review_count + rating_source.
what_i_need_to_proceed.seed_confirmation: Confirm seed scope = config/thresholds.json seed_scope: treatments [botox, lip-filler, coolsculpting, laser-hair-removal, microneedling] x neighborhoods [brickell, coral-gables, south-beach, coconut-grove] = up to 20 pages.

items.note_on_publish_boundary: Whenever the Vercel/Cloudflare publish does happen, that is the hard-gated deploy step and must be a human (or separately-permissioned) action. The builder only commits generated pages to the auto/build branch; it never deploys.
